summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays a pop-up message offering a subscription to "Spinnr All-Access." The main features highlighted in the pop-up include:

- Access to the full music library
- Unlimited online streaming
- Ability to play music offline
- No data charges
- No ads

There are two buttons at the bottom of the pop-up: one to subscribe ("YES, I WANT THAT!") and another to try a 30-second preview ("TRY 30 SEC"). The background shows a music player interface with a list of songs by Justin Bieber.
